query:
UPDATE executions
            SET status = 'failed',
                error = 'async_wall_clock',
                worker_id = NULL,
                lease_expires_at = NULL,
                completed_at = now()
          WHERE status = 'executing'
            AND request IS NOT NULL
            AND started_at IS NOT NULL
            AND started_at < now() - make_interval(secs => $1)
